LESSON: WATER

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.3: Water

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Water. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. observe different sources of water in the immediate environment
2. appreciate different sources of water in the immediate environment.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. observe different sources of water in the immediate environment
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to observe different sources of water in the immediate environment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. appreciate different sources of water in the immediate environment.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate different sources of water in the immediate environment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Water.
2. Explain Water to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
